description: Source code for the Zephyr driver for the SHT4X sensor, implementing I2C communication, CRC validation, sensor data fetching, and configuration.

methods.name: sht4x_compute_crc
methods.description: Computes CRC for a 16-bit sensor value using specified polynomial and initial value.

methods.name: sht4x_write_command
methods.description: Sends a command byte to the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: sht4x_read_sample
methods.description: Reads temperature and humidity samples from the sensor and validates CRC.

methods.name: sht4x_fetch_with_heater
methods.description: Triggers measurement with heater and reads sensor data.

methods.name: sht4x_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: sht4x_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to physical values for temperature or humidity.

methods.name: sht4x_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as heater power and duration.

methods.name: sht4x_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, resets it, and prepares for operation.
